en: An illustrated industrial panorama showing a large leather factory complex with multiple long brick buildings, tall chimneys emitting smoke, smaller administrative houses, and surrounding fields with hills in the background. The factory is enclosed by fences and bordered by a rail or road line. Beneath the image is multilingual printed text in Hungarian, German, and French identifying the factory as the First Pécs Leather Factory joint-stock company, including its trade name "Sopianae" and founding date. The reverse side is a blank divided-back postcard layout with printed guidelines for address and message.
